prompt: You volunteered to run a weekly community activity, but your school and work load has grown and you are burning out. The group relies on you. What is the most responsible way to step back?

options.text: Just stop showing up, because they will figure something out eventually
Give as much notice as you can, explain honestly that you need to step back, and help hand over your notes and show a replacement the ropes before you leave
Keep going silently until you resent the whole group, then quit suddenly
Invent a dramatic excuse so nobody questions your decision or asks you to stay

explanation: Notice plus a proper handover honours the commitment you made while still protecting your health. Disappearing, silently burning out, or inventing an excuse leaves the group stranded and the trust damaged.
